extension.name: AgentPay x402 — Spend Controls for Spec Kit Agents
extension.description: Set USDC spending caps and execute x402 payments to paid APIs during spec implementation. Zero platform fee on Base L2.
extension.author: AgentPay Team

commands.name: speckit.pay-x402.budget
commands.description: Set a USDC spending cap for this spec before implementation begins

commands.name: speckit.pay-x402.trust
commands.description: Check a counterparty wallet's credit file before paying it anything

commands.name: speckit.pay-x402.pay
commands.description: Pay an x402-enabled API on Base or Solana and retry the request

hooks.prompt: Set a USDC spending cap before implementation? (Prevents agents from overspending on paid APIs)
hooks.description: Prompt to configure spend controls before your agent starts executing tasks
